messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

I couldn't find order Shop···· under (email hidden) It may have been placed with a different email.

What's the full name the order ships to, or the postcode? Either one is enough for me to find it.

Found it, Jacob. Order Shop···· is paid and hasn't shipped yet. It has your Magic M. 40T, the Power K. and the Harlo OS Diagnostics plan, going to (address hidden).

I'm sorry about the wait on the 40T. We gave dates before that we didn't keep. Magic M. expects the units to ship out of the factory on November 12. Once your miner ships from our warehouse to you, the tracking comes straight to your email. You can follow the shipment to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
what do i put in there to find my order tracking?

You don't need to enter anything on that page. It isn't searchable by order. It shows the incoming stock shipments to our warehouses, and each batch card says which orders it covers, for example "Covers orders up to Shop…-A". If your number, Shop····, is at or below a card's cut-off, your order is in that batch. That can shift a little as stock moves between warehouses.

Your order doesn't have a tracking number yet because it hasn't shipped. The tracking link will be emailed to (email hidden) once it ships.
